4. Stagger replica updates or implement a rolling replication schedule to avoid simultaneous full copies.

1. Verify physical integrity and provider status of the primary leased line and replace any faulty fiber or hardware immediately.  
2. Conduct a thorough health check of the backup leased line, correcting any misconfigurations (e.g., MTU, BGP timers) and ensuring it is on a truly independent path.  
3. Implement link‑state monitoring with rapid alerting to detect and isolate flapping before it impacts services.  
4. Perform a scheduled failover test to validate that the backup line remains stable under load.  
5. Document the incident, update the redundancy design, and establish a Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the ISP for guaranteed uptime of both circuits.
